[Pending Restart] - Corrected the tooltip of Spirit of Zandalar and Rallying Cry of the Dragon Slayer to state that they do indeed persist through death, but are not usable in the most recently released raid.
There are now skillcards available for all level 1 abilities. These will be learned after level 10 if slotted.
Fixed an issue where you could cast Hand of Protection on a target carrying a Battleground flag and force them to drop it.

7.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where "Titanic Fury" where it had the wrong duration after the recent server restart.
[Area-52] - the Legendary Mystic Enchantment Burning Darkness is now available on Area-52!

Fixed an issue where Ironsand became "nature" damage, it is now correctly once again Physical Damage, this created buggy interactions and prevented it from working with things like "trauma" despite being a bleed.

5.description: In addition to stat value adjustments additional items have been added to Onyxia's Lair. Mace of the Dragon Knight, Wand of the Noble, Neltharion's Badge, Insignia of the Dragon, Draconic Effigy, and Band of Nyxondra will all come with the arrival of Onyxia.

Preceding the release of Onyxia's Lair, some items have received stat value adjustments to bring them more in line with this season's itemization goals. These items include: Dragonslayer's Signet, Eskhandar's Collar, Halo of Transcendence, Onyxia Tooth Pendant, Ring of Binding, Sapphiron Drape.
Fixed an issue where the normal versions of Gordock Knuckleband and Flattened Elven Ring had half the intended PVE power.
Fixed an issue where the tooltip of Retribution tier 1 Paladin 8 set bonus did not state that it also increased the damage of Seal/Judgement of Vengeance.

The 8 set bonus of the T1 Warrior Might DPS set has been reworked. It now has a new effect: Dealing a critical strike with physical abilities has a chance to grant you 60 attack power, 40 melee haste, or 42 critical strike rating. This effect can only occur once every 15 seconds, and lasts for 10 seconds.

The following items have additionally seen a stat revamp on Thrall: Gyth's Skull, Dragoneye Coif, Tribal War Feathers, Slaghide Gauntlets, Cinderhide Armsplints, Pyremail Wristguards, Flameweave Cuffs, Foresight Girdle, Emberplate Armguards, Tearfall Bracers, Dragonskin Cowl, Phasing Boots, Fluctuating Cloak, Elemental Plate Girdle, Dimly Opalescent Ring. These items had a chance roll stats randomly (the majority of the randomly generated stats were resistance stats) and these items would not keep the same stats when upgraded, for these two reasons have been reworked to prevent this.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Items bought from Edrim Skysong now follow the same 2 hour refund rules as other vendors. Previously you could NEVER return an item bought for mythic coins.
[Requires Launcher Update] Arena gear no longer has 2v2 or 3v3 rating requirements, meaning it can now be purchased if you have high enough 1v1 rating.
Lucky Cards now increase your chance to roll those abilities on Hands of Fate AND Card Swaps.
Your Book of Ascension when summoned now auto-trains all of your ranks.
Pets will now be automatically revived/called when you enter an LFG dungeon.
All vanilla open world leveling quests will now give a small amount of Marks of Ascension.
Auctionhouse sale cut has been increased from 7 to 8%.
Skillcards are now spec-specific and can be slotted and maintained for that specialization. This opens up options for additional skillcard behavior after level 60.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Vampiric Touch & Devouring Plague wasn't able to trigger Darkness while in the Worgen form from the Curse of Arugal Mystic Enchantment.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Absolute Zero was not freezing the stunned targets, any targets stunned by Absolute Zero will now also function as if they're frozen.
"Winter's Mantle" and "Gathering Will" when fully stacked increases the critical strike chance of Fuego and Arctis by 15%, down from 24%.

Winter's Mantle and Gathering Will now provides 30% damage increase per stack to Arctis / Fuego, down from 40%. This will result in a total of 150% damage increase, down from 160% damage increase when fully stacked.

The following changes will roll out shortly after a restart on December 15th. This changelog is posted well in advance to give people the opportunity to prepare for the changes themselves: [Warden of Demonreach] - "Winter's Mantle" and "Gathering Will" now enable Soul of Feugo and Winter's Bite after casting Fuego and Arctis (respectively) at 5 stacks, up from 4 stacks.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Added a Tank Stance as a special tooltip to Defensive Stance, Righteous Fury, Bear Form and Mana-forged Barrier to emphasise they don't stack with each other.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Party Recuperation wasn't always correctly benefitting from Quick Recovery.

[Pending Restart] Party Recuperation has seen a minor rework in how it functions. The base health heal is now baked into the hot itself as a flat value. Furthermore the scaling has been substantially increased.

0.description: [Dire Maul] - Eye of Immol'Thar now have a 25 yard spawn radius with relation to Immol'thar, down from 35 yards.
You can now draft Slice and Dice at level 1 if you know a Cat Form combo point generator.

6.description: [Pending Restart] Blackrock Depths - Emperor Dagran Thaurissan - Emperor will use Grappling Hook on players that he can't reach - pulling them towards him, and he will "prefer" to stay in his throne room now.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Blades of Blood did not properly interact with Hydra's Venom.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Glacial Light did not benefit from or consume the stacks from Water Geyser.

Fixed an issue where Molten Mana from Lava Sweep would proc multiple times on certain spells. As a result, the mana restored from casting from Pyroblast, Fire Blast and Flame Shock based on your attack power has been increased.
[Pending Restart] Reduced the mana cost of Devour Mind by approximately 40%, it will now have a similar mana cost to other single target channel type spells.
[Pending Restart] - The Four Following Lesser REs will become available with the next restart: Lesser Rain of Fire, Lesser Volley, Lesser Healing Touch, Lesser Holy Light.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Winterfall Firebreath would take you out of Metamorphosis.
[Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Winterfall Firebreath was not benefitting from Fragmented Glacier.

5.description: Fixed an issue where the item level of Blade of the Dragon Bone was not upgrading in higher difficulties.

Correct the stats of the Heroic, Normal, and Bloodforged version of; Bonespike Shoulder, Breakwater Legguards, Magically Sealed Bracers, Petrified Bark Shield, Unsophisticated Hand Cannon, Mud Stained Boots, Flattened Elven Ring, Gordok Knuckleband and Oversimplified Stick Chucker to match the stat tweaks done to these items in Mythic Plus

1.description: Fixed an issue causing Shooting Stars to extend the duration of Starfall longer than intended while using Arcanist's Explosion.
Fixed an issue where Improved Consecration debuff would stack with other similar debuffs.

0.description: Fixed an issue where the Arcane Elementals, Fireguard Destroyers and Shadowcasters in Mythic Dungeons were dealing far too much damage in Mythic0. Additionally these three NPCs in particular suffered from a rare bug where they were being "double scaled" from the Mythic+ difficulty increases causing them to deal much higher damage than intended in Mythic+.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Wrath of the Plague could not proc when Wraith was on the target instead of Haunt.

3.description: Removed item "Portable Transmogrifier" from all Store Bundles as it has been deprecated with the release of the new Transmog UI serving the same purpose.

0.description: Restored the Raid Boss training dummy in Booty Bay.

Added additional stable masters (who have their own stabled pets visible and outside of the stable for once!!!) outside the entrance of Stormwind, Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, Ironforge, Undercity and Darnassus.

Two new rings make their way live with the next restart - Gordok Knuckleband and Flattened Elven Ring. These rings are obtainable on all difficulties from the DM:N tribute chest and from the Mythic+ boxes. They are a Strength and Agility variant of a ring that also has Stamina, Expertise and Hit rating.
Removed the option of getting Flightblade Throwing axe from the Strength and Agility option. It is still available from the Misc. option.

5.description: An Agility Counterpart to the newly tuned Unsophisticated Hand Cannon has been added: "Oversimplified Stick Chucker" available from the Mythic+ Cache.
Bonespike Shoulder no longer requires you to be crit to proc and can now proc on block, dodge, parry and non-critical damage taken but now has a 6 second ICD.

The following items have additionally seen a stat revamp on Thrall: Bonespike Shoulder, Breakwater Legguards, Magically Sealed Bracers, Petrified Bark Shield, Unsophisticated Hand Cannon, Mud Stained Boots, Ogre Toothpick Shooter, Gordok Knuckleband.

8.description: [Pending Restart] - Duel! Now rewards 1,000 Marks of Ascension up from 600.

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where some dungeons that had multi-last-boss completions (like blackrock spire being split into LBRS and UBRS and BRD split into BRD - Prison, BRD - Upper City, BRD - Manufactory) would sometimes list the wrong last boss you had to complete when completing the instance.

[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Worldforged Scroll - (insert enchantment) mostly "Maggot Trap" and "You're now a Small Crate" was being spammed in your inventory after completing some Mythic+ dungeons.
Disease Cloud has been re-enabled but now has a 1 second GCD, 30 second cooldown and 10 second duration.
Fixed an issue where some LFG bosses didn't drop dungeon caches.
Fixed an issue where World Bosses could spawn in inaccessible instances in the world (these inaccessible bosses would still update the POI on the map)
The Book of Ascension will now auto train your spells (when learning new abilities and leveling up) while it is summoned.
Health and Mana are no longer fully restored when leveling up in Battlegrounds or Arenas.
Disease Cloud has been temporarily disabled while addressing a few bugs and exploits with the Mystic Enchantment.

5.description: The following items have seen a stat revamp with the launch of M+ on Thrall: Wildfire Cape, Halycon's Spiked Collar, Handcrafted Mastersmith Leggings, Lavacrest Leggings, Force of Will, Imperial Jewel, Fire Striders, Ramstein's Lightning Bolts, Husk of Nerub'enkan, Riptide Shoes, Tempest Talisman, Murmuring Ring, Evil Eye Pendant, Shaggy Leggings, Anastari Heirloom, Pendant of Celerity. These items previously had no identity and were often the "worse" version of another item or missing stats to be competitive. The stats are viewable ingame!

7.description: Fixed an issue where Flesh Hook and a few other Mystic Enchantments had disappeared from the enchanting page after the most recent patch update. (Requires a /reload to see them once logging in).

1.description: The pet demon spell Focused Bursts now deals 25% reduced damage versus players.

0.description: - Eyes of Immol'thar will now be able to range the entire room.
- Eyes of Immol'thar will now have an improved target selection, rarely stacking more than one on the same target.
- Fixed an issue where the Eyes of Immol'thar was not actually damaging Immol'thar upon death.
- Reduced the trash requirement for Upper City by approximately 15% - 18%.
- Emperor Dagran will attempt to select different targets with his charge, rather than having the capability of charging the same target every time.
